# The sittings

45 questions in this corpus have at least one first-hand instance: someone who sat the interview wrote the question down, or an interviewer said they asked it. Everything else in the register is a compiled report or a study bank.

This is the smallest slice and the only one that describes a room. Forty-five questions are not a sample of the industry, and several come from the same post. Read them as testimony, not as a distribution.
